title: Cost Guardian: Offline VPC-safe optimization advisor and guarded config application
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: We need an advisor+executor for cost optimizations (batching and prefix/KV caching recommendations) that works in VPC/private deployments where telemetry and outbound calls are constrained. The feature must provide safe defaults, fully-offline evaluation mode, and a guarded apply/rollback mechanism compatible with customer policies (no outbound telemetry, strict RBAC, KMS-only key usage). This ticket scopes the engineering design and first implementation for Private (VPC/on-prem) clusters and the corresponding guarded operator that can run without contacting Redwood hosted services.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor can generate batching and caching recommendations using only on-cluster metrics and stored prompt traces (no external telemetry).
Recommendations include estimated cost delta and confidence score based on local profiling data.
A guarded apply path exists: a dry-run, staged apply, and automatic rollback trigger when SLO regressions or runtime errors exceed thresholds.
All changes applied by the operator honor customer policy constraints: no internet egress, use customer KMS for config secrets, and enforce RBAC annotations.
Operator can run fully offline with results exported to local storage (encrypted) and human-readable reports for compliance audits.
Unit/integration tests that simulate offline VPC environments and confirm rollback behavior are present and green in CI.
Security review completed and signoff recorded in ticket comments/links.
implementation_notes: Design will be implemented in two components: (1) on-cluster Advisor service that consumes local metrics (prometheus/metrics endpoint) and recent request traces (kept in local ephemeral storage) to compute recommendations; (2) Guarded Executor (K8s operator) that applies config changes using a 3-step workflow: plan -> staged apply (subset of nodes) -> observe -> full promote or rollback. For offline clusters, the Advisor must fall back to deterministic heuristics when history is sparse (e.g., default batching suggestions based on model family and token length distributions). All artifacts (plans, diffs, metrics snapshots) are stored in a customer-controlled S3-compatible bucket or PVC encrypted with customer KMS. Operator will expose a 'dry-run' mode that produces a signed plan file; apply requires operator-level RBAC annotation and an approver signature (GPG or KMS-wrapped attest).
testing_plan: 1) Local integration harness: run Advisor against synthetic traffic replay stored in test fixtures and validate recommendation delta calculation. 2) VPC/offline simulator: block egress and validate no outbound connections, verify KMS integration with mock HSM. 3) Rollback scenarios: fail the staged apply (introduce latency and token errors) and assert automatic rollback within configured window. 4) Performance test: ensure Advisor profiling adds <2% CPU overhead on serving nodes. Tests are automated and included under //infra/cost-automation/tests.
rollout_plan: Alpha rollout to internal private clusters: enable Advisor in dry-run, collect feedback for 2 weeks, then enable staged apply with a single customer-simulated namespace. Beta with 3 pilot customers on Dedicated/VPC: provide training and runbook. GA only after security review, legal signoff for offline data handling, and 2 consecutive weeks of stable metrics. Rollback strategy: operator supports immediate abort and a historical snapshot restoration; operators will default to 'do-not-apply' if policy checks fail.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Incorrect batching recommendation causes latency SLO regressions. Mitigation: staged apply, canary traffic split, and automatic rollback detection via latency thresholds.
Risk: Advisor attempts external telemetry. Mitigation: network namespace egress policy and unit tests that assert attempts to call external endpoints fail the build.
Risk: Secrets leakage during plan export. Mitigation: enforce encryption-at-rest with customer KMS and require operator SCM to be in offline-only mode unless explicit opt-in.
Risk: Operator failure during apply. Mitigation: maintain leader-election with safe checkpointing and idempotent apply steps.
notes: PM input: customers frequently ask for safe, auditable cost recommendations for private deployments. Design must prioritize explainer output for compliance teams (what changed, why, rollback proof). Research: Mariana (Applied ML) will supply heuristics mapping model family + seq dist -> initial batching defaults.
